title: [Important] Getting the most out of this course

cues.en: -: I want to say a few things that will help you get the most out of this course.
cues.zh: 我想先說幾件事，幫助你從這門課得到最多收穫。

cues.en: First of all, take notes.
cues.zh: 首先，要做筆記。

cues.en: Just watching the videos is already pretty good, but that tends to lead to a kind of superficial knowledge, which means you might understand everything I'm saying
cues.zh: 只看影片已經很不錯，但這往往會讓知識停留在表面。也就是說，看影片時，你可能理解我在講座中說的所有內容，

cues.en: in the lecture while you're watching it, but you might not remember it a week later.
cues.zh: 但一個星期後，可能就不記得了。

cues.en: There's a lot of empirical research, backed by statistics, showing that comprehension and memory are much better when taking notes by hand,
cues.zh: 有很多受到統計支持的實證研究顯示，手寫筆記時，理解與記憶的效果，

cues.en: compared to taking notes on your computer.
cues.zh: 比在電腦上做筆記更好。

cues.en: Second, pause the video a lot.
cues.zh: 第二，要經常暫停影片。

cues.en: Like, as often as you want.
cues.zh: 你想暫停多常都可以。

cues.en: I will encourage you to pause the video throughout this course, in order to think through an answer, or work through an equation, or write some code.
cues.zh: 課程中，我會鼓勵你暫停影片，思考答案、推導方程式，或寫一些程式碼。

cues.en: I really want you to be engaged and active in the learning process.
cues.zh: 我真的希望你能投入學習過程，主動參與。

cues.en: Now, I do try to make my lectures fun and engaging, but, you know, this isn't passive entertainment, this is active learning.
cues.zh: 我確實會盡量讓講座有趣、吸引人，但這不是被動娛樂，而是主動學習。

cues.en: And I hope that you'll help me teach you by staying engaged in the lectures.
cues.zh: 希望你持續投入講座，幫助我把內容教給你。

cues.en: Third, a few things about the computer code in this course.
cues.zh: 第三，談幾件關於本課程程式碼的事。

cues.en: Even if you are more interested in the theory and the intuition and the math, and you're not really interested in the code per se, I still recommend watching the coding videos,
cues.zh: 即使你比較關心理論、直覺與數學，對程式碼本身不太感興趣，我仍建議觀看程式實作影片，

cues.en: because there are concepts and issues that come up when implementing statistics on computers that you might not get just from looking at the slides.
cues.zh: 因為在電腦上實作統計時，會遇到一些光看投影片可能接觸不到的概念與問題。

cues.en: And so, I talk about these kinds of implementational practical details in more depth in the coding lectures.
cues.zh: 所以在程式實作講座中，我會更深入討論這類實作上的實務細節。

cues.en: So you'll still get a lot out of the coding videos, even if you're not following along with the code per se.
cues.zh: 因此，即使不實際跟著寫程式，仍能從程式實作影片得到很多收穫。

cues.en: Now, all the code videos are in both MATLAB and in Python, so you can use whichever language you're more comfortable with.
cues.zh: 所有程式實作影片都有 MATLAB 與 Python 版本，可以使用自己比較熟悉的語言。

cues.en: Now, you definitely do not need to be an expert in either of these programming languages in order to do well in this course.
cues.zh: 要學好這門課，絕對不需要成為任何一種語言的專家。

cues.en: However, I do not cover elementary, beginner-level programming skills.
cues.zh: 不過，我不會介紹最基礎的初學者程式設計技能。

cues.en: So if you have no experience whatsoever with MATLAB or Python, then you might wanna take an intro-level coding course first
cues.zh: 所以如果完全沒有 MATLAB 或 Python 經驗，可能要先上一門入門程式設計課，

cues.en: and then come back to this course.
cues.zh: 再回來上這門課。

cues.en: Now, if you are comfortable with variables, and for loops, and basic plotting, then you'll be fine.
cues.zh: 如果你熟悉變數、for 迴圈與基本繪圖，就沒問題。

cues.en: I do take the time to explain the more advanced coding techniques that I'm using, so as long as you have some basic familiarity with coding, you're good to go.
cues.zh: 我會花時間說明用到的進階程式技巧，所以只要稍微熟悉程式設計，就可以開始。

cues.en: If you are familiar with both MATLAB and Python, then I recommend going through the course in MATLAB.
cues.zh: 如果 MATLAB 和 Python 都熟悉，我建議使用 MATLAB 上這門課。

cues.en: MATLAB is a more comfortable environment for numerical processing and data visualization, and in my opinion, it's simply easier to follow along in MATLAB.
cues.zh: MATLAB 在數值處理與資料視覺化方面，提供較方便的環境。以我的看法，用 MATLAB 跟著操作比較容易。

cues.en: However, you will need access to the statistics and machine learning toolbox for most of this course.
cues.zh: 不過，課程大部分內容，需要使用 Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox。

cues.en: The fourth thing I want to discuss is that if you already have some experience with statistics, then some of the topics in this course might already be familiar to you.
cues.zh: 第四，如果已經有一些統計經驗，課程中的某些主題可能已經很熟悉。

cues.en: Of course, you are free to skip any videos you like, or watch them in any order, but I created this course to flow in a specific way,
cues.zh: 當然，你可以跳過任何影片，或依任何順序觀看。但我設計這門課時，安排了特定的進行順序，

cues.en: and so I do recommend going through the lectures in order, just in case there's some new details that you might not be familiar with.
cues.zh: 所以建議依序觀看講座，以免錯過一些可能還不熟悉的新細節。

cues.en: Fortunately, on the Udemy video player, you can adjust the playback speed, so you can actually set the videos to go at twice their normal speed.
cues.zh: 幸好，Udemy 播放器能調整播放速度，所以可以把影片設為兩倍速。

cues.en: That's a good way to get through familiar material quickly, and of course you can go back and slow down the video if there's something new.
cues.zh: 這是快速看過熟悉內容的好方法。當然，如果出現新內容，也能回頭放慢。

cues.en: The last thing I want to mention here is that Udemy will ask you to leave a review of this course after only the first few lectures.
cues.zh: 最後要提的是，Udemy 會在才看完前幾堂講座時，就請你為課程留下評價。

cues.en: Now, that's probably a little bit too early for you to feel confident about rating this course, so you should feel free to click on the "remind me later" option.
cues.zh: 那時要有把握地評價課程，可能還太早，所以大可點選「稍後提醒我」。

cues.en: However, when you are ready to leave a rating for the course, then please do.
cues.zh: 不過，等你準備好評價課程時，請務必留下評價。

cues.en: It means a lot to me.
cues.zh: 這對我意義重大。

cues.en: I really appreciate it.
cues.zh: 我非常感謝。

cues.en: It helps future students make a decision about whether they should enroll in this course, and it also helps to support me to make more courses for you in the future.
cues.zh: 這能幫助未來學生決定是否報名，也能支持我在未來為你製作更多課程。
